Elena Gomez: Quick coord for candidate Priyanka Shah visiting our satellite office (7/18). ETA 08:30 PT. Need an on-site host, pre-registered badge, and a small secure locker for medication (she9s bringing an EpiPen).
Marcus Young: I can host AM. I9ll meet at lobby 08:20. Which meeting room are we using?
People Ops: Marking Corner Hub Room A for the loop. Facilities, can you reserve a locker and confirm building visitor prereg? Also any parking notes for satellite?
Facilities: Locker reserved: Secure Locker #7. We'll provide a one-time 4-digit code at check-in. Building requires pre-reg with full name + DOB for security; please DM details. No guest parking onsite  we added street permit link and nearby garage info to the invite.
Reception Bot: Check-in script updated: "Ask for ID, verify pre-reg, print visitor badge, provide locker code, call Marcus in lobby."

IT Desk: Inventory query:
```
loaners.query(os="linux", date="2024-07-18") => [LN-58 (ThinkPad w/Ubuntu), LN-61 (Dell w/Pop_OS)]
```
IT Desk: Reserving LN-58 (tag PRI-2034). We'll image with Ubuntu, pre-clone the demo repo, include USB-C hub+HDMI adapter, and create a local user that expires at EOD. Network egress will be disabled for the demo VM.
Marcus Young: Can you leave the loaner at Corner Hub Room A and drop the charger at reception as a backup? I9ll bring an extra HDMI cable too.
IT Desk: Yes	loaner will be staged in Room A, charger and adapter left with reception.
People Ops: Priyanka also asked about reimbursement for rideshare from BART; our policy covers up to $80. I'll include the claim form and instructions in the confirmation email. She also requested quiet breaks between panels for medication checks; I've added a 20-minute buffer between interviews.
Elena Gomez: Also: she requested scent-free environment for medical reasons. Facilities and catering	please ensure cleaning team uses fragrance-free products and lunch is labeled low-scent vegetarian.
Facilities: Noted. Housekeeping will use fragrance-free supplies that morning. Catering will provide sealed low-scent boxed lunches labeled "vegetarian, no nuts".
Reception Bot: Badge pre-registration completed (Priyanka Shah, DOB 1991-04-12)	badge to be printed on arrival. Locker code (one-time): 7421 will be given at check-in. Street parking link and garage map attached to invite.
Marcus Young: I'll meet her at lobby and escort to Room A. If security needs anything else, ping me.
IT Desk: Loaner LN-58 imaging complete and reserved under PRI-2034. Repo pre-cloned to /home/guest/demo (offline). Device will be left in Room A by 07:45.
People Ops: Pre-visit email sent with arrival instructions, parking/garage map, rideshare reimbursement info, note about scent-free environment, and what to bring (ID, any allergy meds). Also included brief agenda and contact cell for Marcus.
Elena Gomez: Great work. Please confirm here once badge is printed and loaner staged.
Reception Bot: Badge printed and staged. Locker code handed to candidate at check-in. Loaner staged in Corner Hub Room A. All set.
People Ops: Checklist complete: host assigned, badge pre-reg, locker reserved, loaner staged, catering/dietary handled, scent-free cleaning requested, reimbursement instructions sent, buffers added. Closing thread	good luck to the loop! :white_check_mark:
